findings.description: The old code made one `catalog.get_many(locale, wanted)` call. The new loop calls `catalog.exists` and then `catalog.get` for every key and every locale in the chain. That is up to 2 * keys * chain-length catalog calls per bundle. If the catalog is backed by a DB or remote store, this becomes an N+1 query pattern on every page render.
findings.suggestion: Fetch with `get_many` once per locale in the chain, only for the keys still unresolved, and merge the results.
findings.title: Per-key exists/get calls replace the single batched get_many lookup
